title: Can You Come to the Party?

vocabulary.meaning_en: a small place that sells coffee, tea and snacks
vocabulary.example: We meet at the coffee shop every morning.

vocabulary.meaning_en: liked more than all the others
vocabulary.example: Green is my favorite color.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a shop that sells books
vocabulary.note_ar: انتبه: library مكتبة للاستعارة، و bookstore لشراء الكتب.
vocabulary.note_en: A library lends books; a bookstore sells them.
vocabulary.example: I bought a new dictionary at the bookstore.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a place where you buy and eat meals
vocabulary.example: The restaurant opens at noon.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a building where people watch plays and shows
vocabulary.example: The school play is at the theater tonight.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a time when friends meet to eat, talk and have fun
vocabulary.example: We are having a small party for my brother's graduation.

vocabulary.meaning_en: an official card that says you can drive a car
vocabulary.example: My sister has her driver's license now.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a set of questions or tasks to check what you know or can do
vocabulary.note_ar: نقول take a test أي يخضع لاختبار.
vocabulary.example: I have a math test on Monday.

vocabulary.meaning_en: an electronic machine for working with information
vocabulary.example: The first part of the test is on the computer.

vocabulary.meaning_en: in the hours when it is light
vocabulary.example: The shop is open during the day.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the time when it is dark
vocabulary.example: The stars are bright at night.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to take something with you to a place
vocabulary.example: Please bring your book to class.

vocabulary.meaning_en: things that people eat
vocabulary.example: Everyone can bring some food.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to do something in front of people to entertain them
vocabulary.example: The children perform a short play at school.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to say a poem or text from memory in front of people
vocabulary.example: He can recite a long poem.

vocabulary.meaning_en: poems in general
vocabulary.note_ar: poem قصيدة واحدة، poetry الشعر عمومًا، poet الشاعر.
vocabulary.note_en: poem = one piece; poetry = poems in general; poet = the writer.
vocabulary.example: My grandfather loves Arabic poetry.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a small magic act with playing cards
vocabulary.example: My cousin showed us a card trick.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to choose
vocabulary.example: Pick a number from one to ten.

vocabulary.meaning_en: any other thing
vocabulary.example: Do you need anything else from the store?

vocabulary.meaning_en: no person
vocabulary.note_ar: يأتي بعدها فعل مفرد: Nobody knows.
vocabulary.note_en: Use a singular verb: Nobody knows.
vocabulary.example: Nobody is at home right now.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to make food hot and ready to eat
vocabulary.note_en: cook is also a noun: a person who cooks.
vocabulary.example: I can't cook, but I can make tea.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to make music with your voice
vocabulary.example: The children sing a song at the school event.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to do something again and again to get better
vocabulary.note_ar: في بريطانيا الفعل practise والاسم practice.
vocabulary.example: I practice my English every day.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to go to shops to buy things
vocabulary.example: We go shopping on Saturday mornings.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to make things easier for someone
vocabulary.example: Can you help me with my bags?

vocabulary.meaning_en: having a lot to do
vocabulary.example: I'm not busy right now.

fine_lines.title: can vs have to
fine_lines.explanation_ar: can تعني «أستطيع» (قدرة أو إمكانية أو إذن). have to تعني «يجب عليّ / مضطر» (شيء ضروري). Marsha تقول You can bring food أي تستطيع أن تُحضر طعامًا إن أردت، وAnna تقول I have to get my driver's license أي هذا أمر لا بد منه.
fine_lines.explanation_en: can = you are able to or you may (ability, possibility, permission). have to = it is necessary. 'You can bring food' means it is possible. 'I have to take a test' means it is necessary.

examples.sentence: You can sit here if you want.
I have to go to work at eight.
Students have to wear a uniform.

fine_lines.title: can vs can't (pronunciation)
fine_lines.explanation_ar: في الجملة الموجبة تُنطق can خفيفة وسريعة /kən/، أما can't فتُنطق قوية وطويلة /kænt/ (وفي بريطانيا /kɑːnt/). الصوت القوي يساعدك على تمييز النفي.
fine_lines.explanation_en: In a positive sentence, can is short and weak: /kən/. can't is strong and long: /kænt/ (UK /kɑːnt/). Listen for the strong vowel to hear the negative.

examples.sentence: I can come on Saturday night.
Sorry, I can't come with you.

fine_lines.title: with vs to
fine_lines.explanation_ar: come with + شخص (يأتي مع شخص)، و come to + مكان أو حدث (يأتي إلى مكان). في الدرس: Can you come with me? و Can you come to the party?
fine_lines.explanation_en: come with + a person; come to + a place or an event. 'Can you come with me?' / 'Can you come to the party?'

examples.sentence: Can you come with me to the bank?
Can you come to my house on Friday?

expressions.meaning_en: a polite way to invite someone to go with you
expressions.example: I'm going to the market. Can you come with me?

expressions.meaning_en: a polite way to say no to an invitation
expressions.example: Sorry, I can't. I have to study tonight.

expressions.meaning_ar: يجب عليّ أن ... / أنا مضطر أن ...
expressions.meaning_en: used to say something is necessary for you
expressions.example: I have to call my mother.

expressions.phrase: Will you be busy all day?
expressions.meaning_en: asking if someone has free time on a day
expressions.example: Will you be busy all day on Sunday?
Can you help me carry this box?
A picnic in the park? That sounds like fun.

expressions.meaning_ar: هل تستطيع فعل أي شيء آخر؟
expressions.meaning_en: asking about another skill or option
expressions.example: You can draw. Can you do anything else?

expressions.meaning_en: said when you find the right answer or idea
expressions.example: That's it! We can meet at the library.

expressions.meaning_en: saying you have free time at this moment
expressions.example: I'm not busy right now. How can I help?

expressions.meaning_en: an invitation to start going together
expressions.example: The bus is here. Let's go!

grammar.title: can / can't for ability and possibility
grammar.explanation_ar: 1) نستخدم can + الفعل في صيغته الأصلية للتعبير عن القدرة: I can sing. 2) لا نضيف s ولا to بعد can: She can cook (وليس cans أو can to cook). 3) النفي: can't أو cannot: I can't cook. 4) السؤال: نقدّم can على الفاعل: Can you perform? والإجابة القصيرة: Yes, I can. / No, I can't. 5) نستخدمها أيضًا للإمكانية أو الإذن: You can bring food.
grammar.explanation_en: 1) Use can + base verb for ability: I can sing. 2) No -s and no 'to' after can: She can cook. 3) Negative: can't / cannot. 4) Question: put can before the subject: Can you perform? Short answers: Yes, I can. / No, I can't. 5) can also shows possibility or permission: You can bring food.
examples: Can you do a card trick? — Yes, I can.

grammar.title: have to / has to for necessity
grammar.explanation_ar: 1) have to + الفعل الأصلي تعني أن الشيء ضروري: I have to take a test. 2) مع he / she / it نقول has to: She has to work. 3) النفي: don't / doesn't have to تعني «ليس ضروريًا»: You don't have to bring anything. 4) السؤال: Do you have to ...?
grammar.explanation_en: 1) have to + base verb means something is necessary: I have to take a test. 2) With he/she/it use has to. 3) Negative: don't/doesn't have to = it is not necessary. 4) Question: Do you have to ...?
examples: I have to get my driver's license.
Marsha has to help her friend.
You don't have to bring food.
Do you have to work on Saturday?

questions.question: Why can't Anna go to the party during the day?
choices: She has to work at the coffee shop
She has to get her driver's license
She has to visit her family
questions.explanation_ar: قالت Anna إنها يجب أن تحصل على رخصة القيادة.
questions.explanation_en: Anna says she has to get her driver's license.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
questions.explanation_ar: بعد can يأتي الفعل الأصلي بدون s وبدون to.
questions.explanation_en: After can, use the base verb with no -s and no 'to'.

questions.question: Can you cook? — No, I ____.
questions.explanation_ar: الإجابة القصيرة المنفية لسؤال Can you ...? هي No, I can't.
questions.explanation_en: The short negative answer to 'Can you ...?' is 'No, I can't.'

questions.question: What does 'recite poetry' mean?
questions.explanation_ar: recite poetry تعني إلقاء الشعر من الذاكرة.
questions.explanation_en: To recite poetry means to say poems from memory in front of people.

questions.question: Marsha ____ help her friend with the party.
Which sentence shows something is NECESSARY?
choices: I have to take a test.
questions.explanation_ar: have to تعبّر عن الضرورة، أما can فتعبّر عن القدرة أو الإمكانية.
questions.explanation_en: have to shows necessity; can shows ability or possibility.

questions.question: Can you come ____ me to the store?
When is the party?
questions.explanation_en: The party is on Saturday night.

questions.question: What will Anna do at the party in the end?
questions.explanation_ar: قالت Marsha في النهاية: You can sing at the party.
questions.explanation_en: At the end Marsha says, 'You can sing at the party.'

questions.question: Choose the correct question.
questions.explanation_ar: في السؤال نضع can قبل الفاعل ثم الفعل الأصلي.
questions.explanation_en: In a question, put can before the subject, then the base verb.
